svg.title: The first co-branded card across all Lazada markets
svg.desc: Led LazCard with VIB, with sign-up and identity checks inside the Lazada app, and brought VPBank on as a payments partner. More card, less cash on delivery: card orders get cancelled less and settle faster. Lazada · bank partnerships · Best Employee Award 2023.
